old_caption: The video captures a close-up scene on a wooden surface where a white, porous object resembling a piece of foam is placed. A knife is positioned above the object, poised to cut. As the video progresses, the knife makes contact with the foam, slicing through it. The foam splits into two distinct pieces, revealing its internal structure, which includes hollow cavities and intricate details. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing tightly on the action, ensuring that the viewer's attention is drawn to the precise moment of the cut and the resulting separation of the foam into two parts. The lighting is consistent, highlighting the texture and color of the foam against the warm tones of the wooden background.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up scene on a wooden surface where a white, porous object resembling a piece of foam or a model of a bone is placed. A pair of black-handled scissors is positioned above the object, poised to cut. As the video progresses, the scissors make contact with the foam, slicing through it cleanly. The foam splits into two distinct pieces, revealing its internal structure, which includes hollow cavities and intricate details. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing tightly on the action, ensuring that the viewer's attention is drawn to the precise moment of the cut and the resulting separation of the foam into two parts. The lighting is consistent, highlighting the texture and color of the foam against the warm tones of the wooden background.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a white foam object on a tan wooden tabletop against a dark, blurred background. The foam comprises a solid rectangular block on the left joined to a row of upright wavy zigzag walls on the right. A metal knife blade is already angled into the block near their junction. Early in the clip the blade sinks lower within the cut while the wavy wall section remains largely upright, then it progressively tilts and leans to the right, rotating about its base toward a clear diagonal slant. As the foam tips away, the blade recedes toward the upper-left, slipping mostly out of frame. The dark opening in the walls translates and changes shape with the lean, the cast shadow shifts, and the rectangular block remains largely fixed.
